text_block_list.text:
Running with emotion makes Эйсин Флэш
realize
something for the first time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her rivals may have unyielding tenacity
and what
it takes to make the final step
toward victory, but
Eishin Flash desires
to surpass them and become
number
one.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And when she's chosen to be highlighted
in a
special article, she vows not only to
be a "flash"
of greatness, but a lasting
light that will shine on
to the very end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even as the "end" of her schedule looms
on the
horizon, I continue to push Eishin
Flash toward
her greatest goal—the
autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
